<!-- __CODSPEED_PERFORMANCE_REPORT_COMMENT__ -->
## Merging this PR will **degrade performance by 4.42%**

<details>
<summary>:warning: <b>Different runtime env

Comments Outside Diff

These findings could not be posted inline. -

outstanding_asks.ask: **`ref` silently dropped when `DataTable` has an `id`** `Component._render(props=None)` auto-populates `ref` via `self.ref` / `self.get_ref()` only in the `props is None` branch. `DataTable._render` now builds the props dict itself and passes it to `super()._render(props=props)`, which takes the `else` branch and skips that logic entirely. Any `DataTable` constructed with an explicit `id` would previously have had a React `ref` included in the rendered output; that ref is silently absent now.

**Stub manifest not updated** This PR changes component definitions, including the new `copy_with` API, but does not update `pyi_hashes.json`. The repository requires running `uv run python scripts/make_pyi.py` after adding or modifying components and committing the updated hash manifest, not generated `.pyi` files. Please satisfy that requirement before merging. **Context Used:** CLAUDE.md (source)

P1: The rebuilt `VarData` drops `field_dependencies` and `app_wraps`, so styling a Bare can make state-driven content stop tracking all of its source fields and can prevent required app wrappers from being collected. Preserve those fields when rebuilding the metadata, or replace the existing `VarData` while changing only `components`.

P2: `_literalize_static_ids` no longer handles components embedded in `Var` props. Rebuild the `VarData` and its `components` entries with literalized copies, as `Bare._add_style_recursive` does, so head components reachable through `Bare.contents` do not retain `useRef` hooks.

P2: This derived prop becomes stale when a caller uses `copy_with()` to replace `columns` or `data`: the rendered `get_cell_content` keeps the old digest, but `add_hooks()` emits a function using the new digest, so the grid references an undeclared callback. Recompute `get_cell_content` whenever either input is copied, or make hook generation use the stored callback consistently.

P2: This bypasses `_get_all_var_data()`, so styling stops reaching components carried by converted or cached/composed Vars when their components exist only in the merged metadata. Use `self.contents._get_all_var_data()` here so the recursive rebuild sees the same embedded components as the other Bare traversal methods.

P2: `referenced` matches `getCellContent:name`, but Reflex renders component props as JSX attributes (`key={value}`), so the compiled output contains `getCellContent={getData_...}` — the colon pattern matches nothing, `referenced` is empty, and `assert len(referenced) == 2` always fails. Match the attribute form (or both forms) instead of hard-coding the colon format, and confirm the pattern against real compiled output.

P2: Switching `self.style.pop("padding")` to `self.style.get("padding")` changes rendered output: the padding key now stays in `self.style`, so `_merge_app_style` (component.py `new_style.update(self.style)`) and `format_as_emotion` emit it as a top-level rule for the component root *in addition* to the `& textarea` rule. Previously the pop removed it, so only the inner `& textarea` element was padded. If the root element wraps the textarea, both now receive padding (double spacing); at minimum the rendered style set for TextArea changes as a side effect of an immutability refactor. Build a cleaned style without the key and pass it through `copy_with`, as `DebounceInput.create` does with `cleaned_child_style`, so the padding stays immutable while the component root keeps its original (unpadded) style.

P2: `super()._render()` serializes each concrete dataframe once before `remove_props` discards it, so rendering performs the full dataframe conversion twice. Pass the derived props to `_render` directly so only the serialized columns and data are converted.

P2: `RADIX_TO_LUCIDE_SIZE[props["size"]]` raises a raw `KeyError` when a user passes any string that is not "1"-"4" (e.g. size="5"), since the value is validated only by a dict lookup on this line. Raise a clear `ValueError` listing the accepted sizes instead of surfacing the incidental KeyError.
P3: Update `pyi_hashes.json` by running `uv run python scripts/make_pyi.py`; this change adds a component API and the repository tracks generated-stub hashes in that manifest.

P3: `result._get_all_hooks()` only descends into `children`, but `script` lives in the `content` prop, so this assertion passes for the unliteralized `head` as well and never exercises the copy path the test claims to check. Assert on refs instead, since `Component._get_all_refs()` does traverse components stored as props: `assert not result._get_all_refs()` alongside the existing render assertions (optionally `assert "ref_prop_probe" in head._get_all_refs()` on the original).

P3: This PR made `_add_style_recursive` return a new component via `copy_with` instead of mutating in place, but `compiler.py:1393` still discards the result: `hydrate_fallback._add_style_recursive(app.style)` now styles only a temporary copy that is thrown away, and the instance passed to `create_component_memo` is left un-styled. Capture the returned component here like the other converted call sites (or drop the call if the memo-compile path re-applies style).

P3: The docstring and test name claim the compiler's hook dedupe collapses the two editors to a single declaration, but the assertions only compare names and hook bodies; compiler dedupe is never exercised (no render/compile step), so the test passes even if dedupe breaks. Either assert the hook appears once when both grids compile into the same page, or reword the docstring/name to what is actually verified.

P3: `copy_with` writes values straight into `__dict__`, so `handle_submit_unique_name` ends up as a raw `str` even though the field is declared `Var[str]`. Every other prop assignment goes through `_post_init`'s `LiteralVar.create` wrapping, so this value is the only prop on the form that is not a `Var`. Wrap it with `LiteralVar.create(...)` to keep the field consistent with its declared type and with any Var-based prop consumers.

P1: This dev pin breaks the internal package's auto-release path: `auto_release_internal.yml` bypasses materialization, while `publish.yml` rejects the pin with `check-dev-pins`, so this source-triggered release cannot publish. Use a published `reflex-base` floor for internal releases or add the release-time repinning step to the internal path before the gate.

The docs suite also finds test_repeated_page_evaluation_isolates_compiler_mutations trying to append to tuple children.
failing_job_findings.evidence: The current-head docs-tests log shows 9 failures: eight enterprise AgGrid pages fail on the frozen _modules assignment and the page-plan test fails with AttributeError: 'tuple' object has no attribute 'append'. Both reflex-docs jobs crash on the same frozen _modules assignment; their gates propagate those failures.
